description: Get Uber H3 cell indices for a bounding box area at a target resolution. Input supports WKT, GeoJSON, ogrinfo extent, and raw coordinate strings.

bbox.description: The geometry to parse. Can be a raw bounding box string ('lat1,lng1,lat2,lng2'), WKT, GeoJSON, or ogrinfo extent. Either 'location' or 'bbox' MUST be provided.

compact.description: Whether to return a compacted list of cells (mixing resolutions) to minimize response size. Defaults to false.

location.description: A text location to search for (e.g. 'San Francisco'). Either 'location' or 'bbox' MUST be provided.

resolution.description: The H3 resolution level, from 0 to 15. (e.g. 7)

return_geometry.description: If true, return GeoJSON FeatureCollection with hex boundary polygons in addition to cell IDs. Defaults to false.

summary_only.description: If true, returns only cell count, sample cells, and map share URL without dumping thousands of cell IDs into context. Ideal for high resolutions. Defaults to false.

name: get_h3_indices
